# THE 100 — Full content

THE 100 is a free 100-day personal movement challenge. Choose your goal — running, walking, run + walk, or cycling — commit for 100 days, and finish what you started. It is bilingual (English and Amharic / አማርኛ), with a private community, automatic Strava sync, and a Telegram bot for check-ins and notifications.

Website: https://chooseyour100.com
Current challenge: September 23, 2026 – December 31, 2026 (100 days)

## The Manifesto

THE 100 isn't about being the fastest, the strongest, or doing the most. It's about choosing something that matters to you — and giving 100% of yourself to it for 100 days.

We all start somewhere different. Your distance is yours. Your journey is yours. Some days will be easy. Some days, showing up will be the hardest part. Both count.

Because the real challenge isn't the distance. It's giving your best, keeping your word, and becoming someone you're proud of. We move individually, but we don't move alone.

100 days. One commitment. Thousands of journeys.

Start where you are. Give 100%. Show up.

## How it works

1. Join THE 100 — Create your free account in under a minute.
2. Your starting point — Choose your activity (running, walking, run + walk, or cycling) and how much you do each week.
3. Choose your goal — Pick a distance you can commit to, recommended for your level, or set your own. Your goal is personal, not a comparison.
4. Commit for 100 days — Confirm your goal and your 100 days begin. Consistency beats intensity — you don't need perfect days, just repeated ones.
5. Log and hit milestones — Record each run, walk, or ride manually or automatically via Strava. Milestones (10, 50, 100 km…) mark the way.
6. Community and finish — Join the private community for accountability. On day 100 you'll have finished what you started — and that's the point.

## Start where you are

Choose a starting point that fits you: THE BEGINNING, THE BUILD, THE CHALLENGE — from 20 km to 1,000+ km. Different distances. Same commitment. These are not rankings.

## Milestones

Every kilometer counts. One step. One activity. One milestone at a time.

## The Founder Challenge

The founder is doing 1,000 km. You don't have to. Every participant chooses their own goal. Start from where you are. Finish what you started.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is THE 100?
THE 100 is a free 100-day personal movement challenge. You choose a goal — running, walking, run + walk, or cycling — commit for 100 days, and log your progress. The only person you're racing is the person you were 100 days ago.

### How does the 100-day challenge work?
Create a free account, choose your activity and how much you do each week, pick a goal we recommend (or set your own), and commit. Log each run, walk, or ride manually or automatically via Strava, and milestones mark your progress toward day 100.

### Is THE 100 free?
Yes. Creating an account, choosing your goal, logging activities, and joining the community are completely free.

### What activities count toward the challenge?
Running, walking, run + walk, and cycling. You can log each activity manually in the app or by Telegram, or connect Strava to sync automatically.

### Do I need to be fit to join?
No. You choose your own goal starting from where you are. A beginner finishing 50 km and a runner finishing 1,000 km are equally successful because you only compete with the person you were 100 days ago.

### When does the challenge start and how long is it?
THE 100 runs for 100 days. The current challenge starts on September 23, 2026 and ends on December 31, 2026.

### How do I track my progress?
Log each activity in the app, send /checkin to the THE 100 Telegram bot, or sync Strava automatically. You can see your day number, total distance, milestones, and streaks in the app.

### Is THE 100 available in Amharic?
Yes. The app and the Telegram bot are fully bilingual in English and Amharic (አማርኛ). You can switch languages any time in the app.

## Telegram bot (@the100days_bot)

- Link your account with a one-tap deep link from the app, then use: /status, /checkin <distance>, /day, /goal, /streaks, /language en|am, /help, /disconnect.
- The bot sends inactivity nudges, weekly recaps, milestone and finish celebrations, and a daily community digest.
- Example: /checkin 8.4 logs an 8.4 km activity.
